verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single community mention that Outlook has a Copilot integration. This suggests in-product AI assistance exists, but nothing documents it producing insights or suggestions from the user's mailbox data. The Graph People API's relevance suggestions are a developer building block, not an in-product user feature, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of in-product AI insights and suggestions, detail on what data Copilot draws on and what it outputs, and hands-on corroboration of suggestion quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: They sometimes miss the Copilot integration, but say copy-pasting into Thunderbird is still faster than using Copilot in Outlook.
